name: sigilfeel
does: The sigil button and its sigils as before (old): a run starting on the press itself, so a quick tap could put down or pick up two, and a sigil snapping between the ground and her stack with the amber ring; or (new, the default) a run only after leash.runAfter seconds held, and the sigil flying between the ground and her stack with a flash in its colour at each end, burning into the ground and sparkling above her head. Sets tuning leash.runAfter and leash.sigilFeel.on.
decision: Holds made deliberate and the transition made magical (Ed, 2026-11-12: "make holds feel more deliberate"; "have a distinct flash with each transition in the sigil colour, and it burns into the ground with a glow and sparkles above the head"); the old kept one switch away to A/B
